name: vec-param-offset
prompt: Shader layer of a soft spotlight whose center is a vec2 parameter and whose color is a vec4 parameter (rgba), plus a falloff slider. Also keep an unannotated uniform for a future control.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: Shader layer with a soft Gaussian spotlight. It has uCenter (vec2, layer uv), uColor (vec4 rgba, where alpha scales intensity), a uFalloff slider (0.02–1.5) and an unannotated uExtra uniform kept for a future control. Not compiled or rendered because no live tools were attached, and the API pack doesn't document @param syntax for vec2/vec4, so the comma-list defaults on uCenter and uColor may not produce Inspector controls.
